newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil south soybean states to see sun this week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil south soybean states to see sun this week.

text.p: Brazil's southern soybean states will see sunshine in the first few days of this week followed by light rains in the state of Parana over the weekend, said independent forecasters Somar Meteorologia.
A cold front moving across the southeast of the country will bring cloudy, rainy weather to the region and also to the center-west, particularly in Minas Gerais and Goias states.

The past week has seen rain in the north of the southeastern region and the center-south of Bahia. The far south has seen sunshine apart from a few light showers in soybean growing regions, Somar said.
In the center-west, there has only been isolated showers in the soybean areas, it added.

Soybean planting in the two key states of Parana and Rio Grande do Sul can begin in October but the peak period this year is likely to be in November due to a delay in bringing in the wheat harvest in some areas.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
